text: Absolutely worth the wait! We got wings with the dry rub and also the pulled pork shoulder sandwich and both were delectable. White BBQ sauce is to die for!

This is a great south side place for tacos - you must try the street corn. The rice is the best I have ever had at a Mexican place. It is spicier and very flavorful. I could have been happy with just that. 
The tacos have some adventurous options. 
I stuck to carnitas and carne asado. But both were incredible. I was really impressed with the toppings bar for the tacos too. Excellent cocktail and great service by Christian. Check this one out for sure.

Ordered two pizzas, one was the original style and the other was their new Big Love style. I used to live downtown and would either dine in or pickup and the pizza was fine not amazing but not terrible I would've given it a 7.1. Since moving a 10-15 minute drive from downtown I ordered delivery yesterday and it was absolute garbage I would've been better ordering from Dominos or Panago! It was so soggy I had to put it on my pizza stone to try to get any resemblance of a pizza out of it. I can only assume that the pizza doesn't travel well at all in which case why offer delivery if your product won't stand the test?

Beautiful ambiance, knowledgeable servers, and incredible menu. Each flavor feels intentionally selected. Beautiful presentation as well. Standouts for me (I'm vegetarian) included the complimentary lemon poppyseed popcorn (so creative!), marinated burrata & pixie tangerines, and maitake mushroom risotto. My family members enjoyed the hamachi crudo and roasted California chicken. Overall, a great place to go to celebrate my sister's graduation. What a treat!

I particularly enjoy the fact that I can get breakfast all day. Cheesecake factory has a nice selection of breakfast style meals you can get all the time. I'm a big fan of poached eggs and they always make my.l Breakfast just right. The breakfast tacos and very handy and tasty. Coffee is always good.

Dirty tables. Dirty counters. Just plain dirty inside. I don't have any expectations except cleanliness and this Taco Bell has failed. I can't find myself to even eat my food.

Updated 2.1.2020:
On my way home I stopped by Taco Bell. I chose to go inside because it's easier to order inside when there is more than one guest. HUGE MISTAKE!

There was no one line but no one at the counter to take my order. I tried to use the automatic order system but the price of what I wanted was different on the menu from what the machine shows so I went to the counter. I ordered my food and waited. I couldn't sit anywhere because every table was either dirty or occupied. While I waited I watched the back of house making our food. Their counters were even worse. The employee working on the food put the food directly on the filthy counter and then wrapped in paper. I had to stop watching.

There were three other groups of three that ordered after us. We all waited 20 minutes for our food. Meanwhile they sure made every effort to get those cars their food. Seven cars drove thru quicker than all of us who had been waiting inside. I already hated this Taco Bell (it's by my house) but they are on my permanent ban list. Never again Taco Bell...you'll never get to "Demolition Man" status with the crap goin on in Reno.

Every time I come in or tell my coworkers about the awesome hospitality specials BL has all day I make sure to mention to ask for Tracy! She is very attentive and friendly, as well as knowledgeable about the menu so every visit day or night is a good experience!

I did it all for tots! So glad they didn't close down as was indicated earlier last year. Let's just say I could eat their tots all day everyday! Service is great too. Bartenders both times I wanna there very attentive and make a great cocktail. Very decent selection of microbrews on draft as well. Definitely a great a lot to hit for last call on the way home. Sunday funday has also proved to be well worth it with their mimosa specials. Not to mention with all the tvs on Sunday you won't miss a game that is for sure!

I initially expected to be a great takeout place, especially for their lunch boxes. But it became a great Saturday night date spot. Bumping with energy and BYO but still doable for a drop in table. I, myself, love the bento boxes, particularly the shrimp hibachi. For apps, the edamame is solid, plenty of salt. The sushi dishes are beautifully crafted, fresh, and full of color. Though you can't go wrong with California rolls, I might suggest the 76ers roll. Pleased to see this place do well. I'll return for a sit down and for take out.

Stopped in at this place just to buy corn and potatoes and I was ignored for a while and then finally approached with very rude behavior. The corn and potatoes were pretty good so I decided to try this place again and hoped that was an isolated incident. Called and asked if I could place an order for crawfish to pick up up at a later time and was immediately told "no" because they were busy with soft shell crap order. I've never heard of a place refusing to take an order when it's more money for their business. Won't return ever again.

We did not feel like cooking tonight and decided to hop in the car and try Russo's for the first time. What a great decision that was! The kids had pepperoni pizza. Of course I stole a slice and it was fantastic. My wife and I shared a chicken Portobello sandwich and wings. Sandwich was on their homemade bread. Absolutely delicious. The wings were hot and juicy and huge that's about all I can say on that. Our kids had a nice chocolate cake and my wife and I shared the best dessert we have ever had, their white chocolate bread pudding. Service was warm and friendly. Atmosphere makes you feel right at home. We will definitely be back.

Tempted by reviews and hit this place. 
Awful food ever tasted. I ordered crab rangoon it taste like frozen stuff brought from local  store, fried and served. My main entree lo mein with chicken was lacked with flavors. Another disgusting entree schezwan chicken which taste really bad. Spent $30 for 2 and witness the worst food. Very over priced for the food not worth it.

I went yesterday and today. Reason being: I got the date wrong to meet my friend.

You order at the counter. And pay. You're given a number. You take a seat with your number. And the food comes out.

So, yesterday, I got a carryout, once I realized I was there on the wrong day, which took about 30 minutes to figure out. WHAT A DUNCE!

My carryout was the Taco of the Month ($5.25) featuring their home-made chorizo, potato, slaw, other things.

Also, I got the mesquite-smoked brisket burnt ends taco ($5.25): romaine, avocado, red onion, salsa roja, cotija, cilantro on a flour tortilla.

Finally I got the Mexican street corn ($3) and asked for it to be removed from the cob.

When I got home, I ate Taco of the Month first. The chorizo was a bit spicy, but it's supposed to be. A good flavor with the other ingredients. I had to add a little sauce to pull everything together.

The corn was NOT off the cob, but I resolved that at home. It was a lot of corn, so I saved some for dinner with the burnt ends taco.

The Mexican street corn is good. The crunch of the corn, the sauce and the cotija cheese are a good taste. Not as good as the last time I had it, but still good.

The mesquite-smoked brisket burnt ends taco was just terrific. Good, hunky pieces of flavorful burnt ends. The romaine was a brilliant addition to the textures. The other ingredients were a good match.

Today, he got the Baja fish taco ($5) and the chicken tinga taco ($4.50)  --smoky, shredded chicken, slaw, red chile

What a shame. The food is excellent, and the kitchen staff is so efficient, talented, and kind. The bartender from New Zealand is abhorrently fat-phobic, and because my partner and I are thin, tried to blithely shame poor people for being fat. We won't be returning as long as he works there.

I really liked the buffet with different dishes and desserts. I loved the golab janbon dessert! 

High quality food and good service with reasonable proce.

I'll definitely go back and I recommend this place.

After doing some online searching for what restaurants the locals like for authentic Greek food, we came to Hellas. What a great choice! Our waiter (Sean?) was so nice. 
My guest is part Greek so she was excited to have the flaming saganaki and the other authentic dishes.  I had the Gyro and it was served warm and flowing over with meat and goodies. 
The decor is over the top which makes it the perfect experience for a fun meal with friends or family. They have their own parking lot in the back and will validate your parking. They also have a huge bakery and creamery attached so you can pick out your dessert for later, as you will be stuffed from dinner!
They maintain good social distancing, covering the tables with butcher paper and then disinfecting between customers, wearing masks and gloves etc. 
We will be back for sure!

The food here was amazing, unquestionably the best pizza in the city. We had their Soppressata pizza and the carbonara and both set high bars. The pizza crust is light with an airy crumb and perfect char. For drinks we had the strawberry Negroni which is made with their in-house strawberry infused Campari and a La Notte Spritz - both were absolutely delicious. 

We will be bringing people to enjoy Bianco with us! Highly recommended!!

Quick, delicious, friendly, AUTHENTIC, and affordable. 

No price gauging, constantly good. We go weekly for lunch!
This Flowing Tides is a hidden treasure. The service is great. The food is very tasty.  It's a friendly atmosphere.

Wonderful for a patio dinner! We enjoyed sausage pizza and eggplant parmesan. Service was friendly and timely. We even sat outside for a while after our meal and felt unhurried which was nice. High recommended!

Ive been to Soulfed several times...Ive had some great meals there and some not so good meals there and that's why I can't give them any higher than 3 stars they are inconsistent. I was so excited to support a black owned business but because I've had some meals there that lacked seasoning, the customer service was just ok, and they are not responsive to messages and calls from customers I have to give 3 stars. I've had the shrimp and crab leg platter, seafood fries, and tang special. I've tried the OG sauce...when its good it's great but depending on the cook for the day it can taste like bland oil. I've also had the Bag sauce which sometimes is flavorful but other times is inedible because its too spicy, the waitress told me the flavor depends on who makes it. Im just disappointed because I paid $40 for one meal just for me and I feel this place is too expensive to be inconsistent

This place is ALWAYS packed! They seem to try different ways to keep the line moving and I give them credit for trying to keep things moving, but I have definitely waited a good 20-30 minutes in the drive through due to the lines. I'm impressed with the accuracy of my order and the friendliness of the employees. I've never had a problem with my order and the menu options are just as delicious as all other locations!
Talk about a home atmosphere and great service, I really enjoy the food selection they offer here, my fave us the egg sandwich on  Cuban Bread with coffee.

Food is good - not out of this world - 
Drinks are a big fat no no - the blue margarita- dont even bother.
The Al pastor - pork taco - is delicious 
Rice is good
Beans - nope! 
Plantains - good
Had a great drinks at O'Charleys. Brady was attentive bartender that served unbelievable margaritas. Would definitely recommend going!

We order the food to our hotel room. The food got to our place less then 20 minutes. The food was amazing. I had the mussels and lobster mac & cheese. Wow!!! The mussels had so much flavor and the lobster Mac & Cheese was creamy and big pieces of lobster.

The food was so so at best. Little to no seasoning. At least one employee walk around clearing tables without a face covering. Multiple groups walked into the restaurant without face coverings. Would not recommend

We tried Off the Grill earlier this week when we were craving burgers. It was so delicious that we decided to order again for our anniversary dinner. (We usually go out somewhere special, but with the pandemic we wanted to keep it safe and stay home.) This time, we decided to order their sirloin tips and grilled chicken. Oh my goodness!! Absolutely delicious!! The meat was tender and the grilled vegetables were perfect! It made our night! We will definitely be ordering from here again. :)
The sandwiches and sides were terrible.  Fries were soggy and hoagies were dry.  Will not be back.  I just threw away the leftovers.
By far one of the best breakfast sandwiches I have ever had. The "Max's Breakfast Sandwich" was amazing. I almost ordered one to go it was that good. Wish I lived nearby as I would go every day.

Brian at this location blew me away with his customer service. The bartender was amazing as well. 

The reviews are harsh about this facility, I believe they made many changes and I would defiantly give it a try. Good is incredible!

We ordered a large Pepperoni Pizza, Arugula Salad and Garlic Knots to go. When we picked up the order it was the wrong pizza, which we noticed as soon as we got back to the car. 

Went back to let them know about the mix up. The person at the window asked why we didn't check our order before we left. He said they have a lot of orders to give out and we should be more careful. 

He reshuffled some orders and couldn't find a Pepperoni Pizza. Then another customer came back with our pizza and the cashier said they mixed up our boxes. He told both of us to pay more attention, in the future. 

Everyone is entitled to a bad day, but that was pretty wild. 

3 stars for otherwise good pizza, salad and garlic knots.

We made a last minute reservation for lunch on the same day and they were able to accommodate us. The food here is amazing! Super delicious in every way!! Lots of great appetizers to pick from and the entreés are so amazing. The restaurant is very spacious and they have an excellent customer service! Try our the drinks coz they mix up some awesome cocktails!
Excellent service, delicious food and the drinks are to die for. Inside is beautiful very cultural  Frida Khalo everywhere
Had take out last night, ready on time and everyone was pleasant. Food was very reasonably priced and excellent quality. Great job!

Didn't know where to go for dinner tonight.  Thinking Chinese, Thai, or Italian.   Figured we go Thai, but was not sure.   

Walked in, seem pretty cool.  Nice ambiance, but not a lot a people given it was Monday.   Then we ordered.   Amazing food.  Great spice, but not too much.  Great staff.  

We will be back for sure.

My husband used to go here as a child and wanted to take me. The atmosphere is beach chic meats nostalgic country and the food was enough for a family of five, even though there was just two of there. If you're looking for a reliably sound establishment, this is it.
First timer from Texas. The real deal. Get the house seasoning. You won't regret it. Shrimp and sausage alone will keep me coming back every single time I visit.

Came in at 11AM on a weekday for one reason: The Darkness. Heard about this pastry, wanted to try it, and got there RIGHT IN TIME. There was only one left! 
Split it with my husband because I love him, but I could have eaten a dozen of these. A dark chocolate croissant, utterly flaky, buttery, and with the right level of salt. A perfect pastry, topped with solid chocolate that had just the right melting point in your moth, and a good feel of sprinkled sugar.
So decadent, divine!  
Easy free street parking.

Despite coming to IRB for our vacation last 4 years, this was our first time here...and we will definitely be back! Visited on a Sunday at 6:30 and were immediately greeted and seated by a friendly young lady.  We started with raw oysters, super fresh, properly shucked (no shell bits) and served ice cold on a bed of ice.  Outstanding!  I ordered the blackened Mahi tacos. Three flour tacos generously filled with fresh perfectly grilled and seasoned fish, served with a side of housemade chips.  Excellent!  But the show stopper for us was the scallops baked on butter, garlic and sherry.  Now, being from New England, we know something about our scallops.  This has to be one of the best prepared scallop dishes we've ever had...ever!  Eight medium size scallops served in a piping hot metal dish in a butter garlic and sherry-sauce topped with breadcrumbs and we think Parmesan cheese, which was then browned under a broiler.  All I needed was a loaf of bread to soak up the sauce.  Our waitress was a doll and the prices were very reasonable.  Will be back again before we leave.

Viman Thai Cuisine is my favorite area restaurant with their tasty food, large portions, decent prices, and friendly service! Did I mention that the order's always ready on time too? The lemongrass chicken, pineapple fried rice with pork, and Pad-See-Ew are some of my favorites--especially the lemongrass chicken, which makes my mouth sing with delight with every bite. A single entree is easily 2 meals, and lately they've been including lotus blossom cookies. These cookies are so beautiful, light, and crispy with a hint of sweetness. Enjoy the 2-sided beautiful of those cookies in the pictures, then place your own order to enjoy their flavor!

While we certainly like the food  served here, we found the service completely lacking for a very simple and avoidable reason

After spending almost forty dollars and having a friendly  chat with the cashier.  I mentioned that I had a severe cold and asked if they hat hot tea that could be ordered while I waited.

The cashier stated that broth might be a great idea.  When I asked for a cup of broth the cashier stated that, although that was a great idea, she could only sell me a large container of it.   When mentioning I was sick and asked again if she could sell or  just give me a cup of the broth while I waited, she stated (laughingly) that's a good idea and she would have to bring it up to the owner

The food  is still good but the flavor if the service is not  good

Tipping point?  Yes.  Having to almost have to beg for a cup of broth (that I would have glaadly paidd for) made this customer feel petty and small 

That good I have a place to vent.  Maybe I am a little  too sensitive
My new fav ice cream place.. service needs to be better , the servers seemed a bit lost

This was my first time to stop here at this outdoor restaurant/bar with live music. The weather here end of July was nice. As you can see from my pics I stopped here for a nice bloody Mary, which I enjoyed. I bought my Bloody from the bar. I seated myself at an available black cast iron table and chair nearest to the live band. I was able to enjoy their live band's local music, while sipping my bloody. I would definitely stop here again to enjoy a cocktail and live music.

Great food and great customer service.  My favorite local restaurant.  The triple cheese Angus burger is really good and I am a fan of the white chocolate banana pudding.  Also happy to support a local, family owned business.
Bomb margaritas!!! Their beerita is awesome!!!! I also ate their shrimp quesadilla, there was soooo much shrimp in there! It was amazing!
The Ramen and Tako Yaki here are really good! I tried the Curry ramen and my wife tried their most popular ramen, both of them are good!

I'm in love with everything Bud & Marilyn's has to offer. From it's retro interior to it's bomb food, B&M's does not disappoint. 

I ordered the classic fried chicken and biscuits which, by the end, I was so full and couldn't finish it. The chicken is perfectly moist and crispy coupled with chewy biscuits.

For dessert we shared the peanut butter chocolate malt cake which was much larger than we expected. One slice definitely satisfied the four of us.

Can't wait for the next time I get to come here!

10/10 would have a farewell dinner here again :')

The food is the absolute worst I have ever tasted. I frequently dine at Vietnamese restaurants, the pho was water and lacked flavor, the meat was under seasoned and insipid. The vermicelli was overcooked. Disappointment

Craving some Greek food? You should check out Opa Opa located in the Trolley Square area of Wilmington. On this trip I dined in and tried the Shrimp Soulvkai platter. Service was very quick, once my order was placed.  The platter was served two skewers of shrimp, rice and French fries. The platter also included a well seasoned Greek salad with fresh tomatoes, cucumbers, and feta cheese. I was really surprised by the portion of food, definitely had leftovers. This place is a must try if you are in the Wilmington area.
Off the hook goodness! Deep dish was the bomb! Chicken wings, best ever.  Don't miss this place!
I had a bacon cheese burger with coleslaw and fries.  Coming from Bartolino's, you know it's going to be good.

Service was pretty good considering how busy they were but the food was only so so, ordered breakfast with eggs over medium, not only was the yokes runny but so were the whites, I couldn't eat them.
The ham was very fatty but the home fries were good .

We made our first visit yesterday. The service was quick, the rose-infused hot mocha decent, and the bites from Village Bakehouse yummy. The cashiers and baristas wore masks and gloves, and they are offering curbside service for customers who do not wish to wear a mask at the drive-up. I'd give them 5 stars if they had touchless card readers. We'll stop in again when we're next in the area.

My wife and I just left after dinner. Our meal came to a total of $67.23. The server dropped our card and the people next to us. When we checked our account we were charged $80.63. When we called to inform the manager she said we were lying and we were only charged 67.23. What a joke! Please for your sake do not go to this place unless you like being ripped off and called liars

I saw this bakery on Instagram and HAD to try their over the top desserts. Everything was unbelievably decadent: cookie dough buttercream bars, gigantic brownies and blondies, every cupcake flavor imaginable, and a whole display case filled with various cookie doughs! I had a sugar cookie funfetti bar topped with chocolate chip cookie dough and cake batter buttercream -- one the best desserts I've ever tasted, and was absolutely huge. The bakery itself is tiny, but it's tucked in an adorable section of South Philly along cobblestone streets and historic townhouses, so it's perfectly located to enjoy your sweets outside in the fresh air.

Went in today to try the chicken pho, and the sushi burrito looked so good I had to try that too. My burrito had shrimp tempura, crab, masago & lots of toppings wrapped in soy paper. All ingredients were really fresh, and it tasted delicious. The staff was super helpful and friendly. This was my first visit, but I definitely see myself as a regular here.
Another great experience at Allin's diner. I got a ham and cheese quesadilla and husband got the traditional slinger. Great food and great service!
The paratha tacos were amazing. Great interior design. Amazing overall concept. Used to be the lodge but was recently converted.

This is a neat place on the northwest side. Beautiful scenery, homemade dairy products, cute store, and lovely restaurant all in one. They offer guided tours or you can roam at you're own leisure. It was chilly day so I chose to pass on the tour, but I want to go back. They also allow you to see the cow milking process if you want which occurs at 7pm. I wanted to try their famous milkshake as I've heard so much about it. I got a vanilla and chocolate shake and it was very rich, tasty, and affordable. I asked the lady  what they are most known for and she said the chocolate milk. She gave me a sample to try and it was delicious. They have a nice parking lot for many guests and outdoor seating to enjoy on nice days. Didn't try the food this time, but it's on my list!

As I entered I stood by the door for say about 10 minutes. The greeter just acknowledged me with a like don't bother me type of "hi" is this really how you guys treat your guests? No wonder it only has 3 stars and going down.
Love this place. Always tasty a very pleasant restaurant with interesting menu. Not to noisy and really nice service

Very good and fresh and really nice people here kind of hard to find location but worth looking for especially if you are vegetarian or vegan because they have a nice selection of tamales my vegan blue corn tamales were excellent

We were seated and never given silverware. I went and got it myself at the hostess stand after I told my waitress and my salad was already there. We ordered sweet tea and got unsweet. I found a hair in 2 of 3 plates. Also when I told the manager, he started looking for someone on the line with that color hair. If I could leave less than one star I would.
They messed up my order and they also don't have a lot of selections for beer the food taste great but on my way back on the road didn't sit well I threw up everything so won't be coming back.
Never been let down. Always satisfied with food quality and especially customer service. Always love seeing the staff and the fresh fish is a plus!! If your in castleton check out caplingers!!

I came here over Labor Day weekend and Mizza was such a treat. I am vegan, my boyfriend is not. We were looking for a nicer place to get dinner in Santa Barbara while visiting and came across Mizza. I was immediately sold based on the fact they have an entire separate vegan/vegetarian menu. For "co ed" places, that's always a good sign in my book. We split the vegan Bruschetta which was absolutely delicious. I am a little bit a of a Bruschetta snob and often make it at home because it's such a delicious and simple dish, but surprisingly hard to get sometimes. Well, either way - theirs did not disappoint. The bread was crisp but soft and soooooo good too. I also had the Beyond Sausage, Mushroom and Broccolini Vegan Pizza which was delightful. They do not use plant-based cheese on the vegan pizzas, instead they're topped with a tomato sauce, veggies and/or meat alternatives, which is fine in my book for a nicer place like this. Keeping it simple as they did, It really brought out all the different flavors of the spicy sausage, the crisp broccoli and juicy tomato sauce. The flavors were phenomenal all around. I will definitely stop by again on my next trip into town!!
The staff wasn't friendly. I felt like I need some instruction to order and didn't get any. It's seems to be more of a take out place than a sit down. It's clean eating.
Love the friendly people and tasty alternative to burgers at the Habit and In and Out when in the mood for fast food!

We love this place. It is in a renovated, old filling station. A casual, cool vibe. The food is just right...great flavors! Servers are attentive and pleasant. In warm weather we love to sit outside in their patios.

We have ordered take out several times during the Covid 19 era. Large menu with lots of choices. Everything we have ordered has been fresh and delicious. The staff is always super friendly and gracious.
It's a neat experience, I've been a few times, hit or miss on the dishes. Definitely come in with an open mind though!

If you haven't  been here you are missing out, 5he level of service is amazing, the food and presentation  are fantastic  and everything  taste as good as it looks. Chris  the manager a d Ashley the server made sure we had an awesome  and very pleasant  experience

Have been going here for the last ten plus years and the quality has really gone downhill. Chicken was inedible, bread was stale, and service was unapologetic - all the way up to the owner! Sad to see the decrease of quality and service at a local favorite. Will not be returning.

Great food, very nice service. Have done a good job adapting to COVID

P.S. the Hawaiian burger needs to make it on to the main menu damn

It is always a lot of people waiting. I am assuming this is a good place for foods. I only ordered take out jambalaya. To be honest, it's too salty and the rice is too wet and soft. It's not as delicious as I thought. I wish I could come to this restaurant next time and therefore I keep the score as four stars.
Racial profiling. Got seated. Then kicked out of our seats. Then seated again because we apparently "seated ourselves"
A great restaurant and so glad to see they continue to thrive. Creative kitchen staff and lovely waitstaff.

I really liked this place! Went on a Saturday for lunch - place was a little crowded, but not bad at all. The parking lot is not large - and it was pretty full. Chips and salsa were PERFECT! Service was good - I got the chicken fajitas and they were good - nice size serving too. Just a really cute place that has great food and good atmosphere and good service...what else could you ask for?

The food and portions here are delicious and HUGE!!! We stopped in one night for dinner and couldn't believe how much food we got for $11 each! The service was really good too. Can't wait to get back!
Friendly, laid back place. Delicious buffalo chicken dip. Perfectly made pineapple mojito.  Cool little backyard patio.

Wow....totallt unexpected.  Came here on a tip from a friend.  Nestled in next to Fred Meyers is this great little unassuming location with great- inexpensive food.  The Pho was fantastic, very authentic flavors, flavorful broth.  So much in the bowl I couldn't make it to my sandwich.  Taro Boba was also delicious.  Service was very friendly and fast.  Self serve, no table service, the food totally makes up for this.  If you like Vietnamese food, you've got to but this place on you bucket list.  Sometimes the best things come from the unexpected.

**Update*** Visited this location previously and had a bad experience but happy to report management made it right and invited my party back! Everything was stellar and I can't wait to return! Food is amazing and atmosphere is fun!

This restaurant is entirely unconcerned about food safety in the time of Covid. Last Wednesday, as I was paying for my takeout order, I noticed one of the employees prepping food had his mask pulled down so his nose was uncovered. I had already paid, but when I got home I realized I was not comfortable with this, and furthermore, that the state of New Jersey has mandated that food service employees have their faces covered. I called and the general manager took my name and number. She asked if I wanted my food remade, which missed the point completely. If an employee prepping the food has his nose uncovered, a new bowl will not solve the problem.
I never heard back, so today, six days later, I went into the store. The general manager gave me my refund, but as she was doing so, she was speaking to a different employee who had her mask pulled down so her nose was uncovered. The manager has not learned a thing. 
Keep in mind that the store discourages anyone from coming inside, which means customers don't see this and have no idea it is happening, which is makes the situation even worse.
I had liked this location well enough, for what it is. Not anymore. I have lost all confidence in their food safety measures, not to mention willingness to follow health guidelines, and will not be returning.

ssssshhhheeeeeeeeiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiitttttttttttttt


#1 ordered pizza from Uber eats (because covid)
#2 ate pizza while sitting on the floor watching Unsolved Mysteries
#3 can die happy now
Lovely spot for breakfast! The breakfast hash is the bees knees! Wait staff was pleasant and the pastries looked scrumptious. If we had more time in the city this would definitely be a double stop.

Shit staff hate young people. 
Was kicked out after I wanted an apology for getting my ID checked multiple times. 
GM came over with a bouncer and when I said that was rude as they left they turned around and kicked me out. 
Wouldn't recommend if you are under 25. Music is good

Wonderful!  Best Bistro we've found in years!
We visited from Calgary and came upon Tiramisu. Everything was just to our taste. In the middle of these crazy times we enjoyed great music, people enjoying meals together, great service, the best long shot Americano coffee we've had in years and above all, great food! I had the Roasted Veggie Omelette which was superb and my partner had a frittata with Elk Sausage. We had a tough time deciding which of their amazing desserts to take on the road. We decided on a hazelnut mousse topped brownie. Yummm. Rich and not so sweet. We'll always come back when we're in town. Great Job!

All I have to say is I hope everyone gets Wyatt as your bartender and server he is AMAZING and truly knows how to keep people happy. Naomi on the other hand is the RUDEST person I've ever met. Unapproachable, worst server, and when we said thank you she doesn't respond to you at all. She literally hands us our water and walks away. We order our drinks and she acts like we are bothering her. We go there a lot but if I knew she was my server I would leave immediately. Nobody looked happy tonight and we totally understand by. If you don't like being a server then change your job. So upset about how rude and how our experience there was ruined tonight.

I love it here and never think to review. I will update more photos next time. They give you large portions and great service. When I eat here, I know I will have a meal for the next two days. 

My favorite dishes are Lobster Carbonara and Gnocchi & Italian Sausage: The lobster is large chunks bathed in butter with peas and creamy sauce. I always ask to remove the bacon. The sausage/gnocchi dish is slightly spicy, but balanced with cool tomato and pillow-like gnocchi that rests on your tongue.

Butter Cake: I usually get the Tiramisu because this is my favorite dessert, but I decided to try the butter cake on my most recent visit. It is likely that I will return just for this cake soon. As the description goes, it is buttery, but it does not taste like eating a stick of butter. It is like a pound cake flavor and the butter takes away the worry that it might be dry. It is perfectly soft and sweet. It contains strawberries and whipped cream on the side (maybe just to go) to add more flavor notes.

I was visiting family and wanted to support a business nearby the house during one of our first dining outings since the pandemic and chose Seasons 52. Although I appreciated the establishment taking precautions during these times with cleanliness and social distance with the spread out seating, the food made the experience quite miserable. Normally when an establishment has a good atmosphere and friendly staff I tend to give a place a second chance. But when one has to power through eating, there's no need to return. The only edible dish was the grilled caramelized sea scallops, but the portion was disappointing. The tuna tartare was presentable but since our server was taking off the lobster bisque and Mac and cheese off the bill, I took one for the team and ate it. My other family members don't even remember what they got because they just want to forget.

It SUCKED Really Bad!!! Will Not Be Back!!! All Tomato items taste just like that( Tomato Sauce).. UHHH, Crab Cakes we're stretch with Chicken & Very Little Crab Meat! The Fried Fish was Pretty & that's all( no seasoning or Cornmeal). The Fried Chicken was Good but VERY SPICY)! Bread Pudding was just that BREAD pudding.
Great place, family restaurant. My go to is the Frank's Special pizza. And the broasted chicken is not to be missed. Easily 5 stars. GO
The margaritas are delicious! Their happy hour is very reasonably priced. The bartender that served me was so friendly. Everyone was so polite, too!

Terrific Pizza, Super Tight Menu

We were on long road trip from Jacksonville Fl to Syracuse NY.  Stopped in Philadelphia for the night. Wife wanted pizza so we turned to YELP for guidance. Number 1 by rating was Ravanesi. Reviews were all good so thought we'd give it a try.

The place reminded me of many of the little pizzaa joints that I went to as a kid in Detroit. These joints were usually run by a single guy. Just a counter, pizza oven and maybe a table or 2. But the pizza was fantastic!

Arrived at 8:45 pm- they were closing at 9.  We asked if we could order to eat in and were told graciously that we could but there would  be a wait.  Every table in this tiny joint was taken.  A total of maybe 8 tables, super simple decor, not in any way fancy.  Everyone working there was simply gracious and eager to please. Great sign of good food- every table taken 15 minutes before closing. Every customer seemed to know the 4 person staff intimately as if everyone was family.

Pizza toppings limited to sausage, pepperoni, onions, arugula, red peppers and a couple types of cheese. Not in anyway, your typical pizza place.

We ordered the Spicy Sopressata+sausage, no olive oil.    

I am a food aholic.  Wife and I lived in Chicago for 23 years. Been to Naples Italy.  We like all types of pizza.  Chicago deep dish, Chicago thin crust, NY style, Detroit deep dish and Neapolitan. We have favorites of each type.  This stop is one of our most memorable.  The pizza was super simple. Very fres
Great gyros! Great service! Food is always ready within 10 minutes and you can easily order through their website. I would recommend to anyone looking for great Greek food.

The food is good but it's simple so honestly it's impossible to mess up. This store will mess everything else up though. It will take over an hour for 2 sandwiches and they will leave it on the ground outside of your apartment building. Every time we order from this store it takes forever. We live 7 minutes away. Order from the store on 116th.

Love the meal, every single time that we come by I enjoy it to the fullest. I love everytime that everyone starts dancing. I've been going for a while now and on every bday they bring the pony and you just have to ride it. So much fun, great ambient and the food never disappoints. Ohhh and what about the tasty bread!!! Amazing

My thoughts and review of The Melting Pot in St. Petersburg, Florida

 The Melting Pot (Saint Petersburg, FL) restaurant chain opened in 1975 outside #Orlando in #Maitland, Florida 25 years after the #Swiss #fondue craze hit the United States and today offers varieties of starter, entree, and dessert fondue dishes along with a full bar, local beers, and an old + new world #wine list. This was our second visit and review to this location, enjoying a regular fondue experience the first time than a #German #Oktoberfest for the second. You can read both full reviews by visiting the Wine Dine and Play blog website.

My new East Nashville favorite spot. After walking around on a busy Saturday at noon, and having so many choices, we decided on Citizen Market. Wonderful coffee (I tried the Americano) and they even offer French Press. Brunch for 2 was $35. I had the muffuletta (selected from a cooler but they warmed it up for me) and was more than pleased. Husband had biscuit with sausage gravy and fruit tea. He was happy with his selection and we both agreed we would return and probably order the same again. They offered Keto desserts as well as non-keto selections. Great little coffee and sandwich shop with tons of choices. Staff were friendly (but not the fake friendly) and highly focused on customer service.
The food is delicious and flavorful & authentic, everything ... the staff is more than friendly, i recommend as of right now. great portions

This is one of my favorite spots in East nash. Other reviews talk about how it's not authentic mexican food, duh its a hipster spot in east nash, why would you expect that? What it is however, is delicious, high quality and unique for the area. It's cash only with the option to pay w venmo during covid. Awesome selections on the menu, favorites are the posole, chilaquiles (on saturdays only) and the fried avocado tacos. Must wear a mask to pick up and order but they have their side patio open for dine in.

First off, apparently not a single front of the house staff member here knows how to properly wear a mask. Noses and mouths all hanging out. Their masks all look like chin covers. 
Then I look towards the kitchen, and see a manager in a red shirt walking around with absolutely no mask on at all. My assumption would lead me to believe that none of the back of house staff is wearing a mask. 
Now there's the fact that my carry out order for boneless wings, took almost an hour. Their excuse, "there's only one cook right now." 
Let me just say, I work in the food industry, so I know how hot and annoying the masks can get. But this is one of the most important businesses that masks should be, being properly worn. For God's sake, you're working with other people's food! It's common sense... For most people!

Terrible!  My beef was so tough I wasn't able to chew it; I did not eat it. My friend could not cut her chicken; she did not eat it. Everything else was average:  the fries, green beans, mashed potatoes, mac and cheese, and French onion soup.  Our server over shared her personal life. The dessert was the best part of our meal:  creme brûlée and banana ice cream. Philadelphia has so many good restaurants; don't waste your time or money here.

I ordered from Hatfield Pizzaria on the 13tb of June.  I ordered a small wings ascends fries. 
I'm disabled and bedridden, so ordered delivery.   
I got a bank notification Wednesday saying my account was overdrawn.  I immediately looked into i!
I was charged $25.20!!!    Way more than three true cost!!!
I called and spoke with a person identifying themself as the manager.  I yolks her what the problem was.   She pulled up three saleon J her register.  The problem was, i was charged for an $8 tip!!!   On a fifteen dollar order!!!   I told them to add a two dollar order-!!!
There's no way Three l spoken word Two sounds anything like the word eigh!!!    So i can only assume this was boo accident, since my order was taken by three driver.   
I'm being charged$33 overdraft fee for their error.  
I told the manager to return my cost for the food and I'll call it even!     If still be out $8
I thought it was morethan fair!!!
She told me she couldn't authorize it So she would talk to the owner about it there next day. 
I called the owner the next day to talk to him about it.   I told him what had happened.  He told me her look at receipts and call me back. He of course never vaccinated back.  
So I'm out a bunch  of money, to me anyway, betting a senior and a disabled vet on a limited income. 
So check your receipts!!!!

Sulimay's is a classic breakfast spot and our go-to in Fishtown/ Kensington! You can't beat their breakfast sandwich and coffee special for $5. This may sound crazy, but with all the great coffee in the neighborhood, Sulimay's is by far the best, IMO. We have ordered take out and dined in the restaurant many times and the food is always quick to come out and delicious. The hash browns are always cooked to perfection! The hot sauce collection is also a great touch, we love trying new ones every time we dine in. As long as we live in the neighborhood, Sulimay's will be our breakfast favorite and go-to.

Great variety of delicious food for lunch or dinner! 
Chef was very accommodating of my dairy allergy. 
And surprised my friend with chocolate cake for her birthday celebration! And it was delicious too!
They have vegan pancakes that you can customize with any vegan toppings you can find. The hash browns with peppers and onions were delicious. Food was served fast and hot and service was outstanding!
Very tasty food. The owners are very nice too. I will definitely visit them again when I am back to St Petersburg.

So this location is extremely busy, but even with all the restrictions they have to follow, they are managing to put out fresh, quality food living up to what I assume are the high standards of this restaurant chain! The staff for the most part are extremely helpful and friendly, although there is one young Asian girl that could use a class in customer service but I'm being picky at this point. The kitchen staff in the times I've gone have their act together and do a great job pumping out the food in a timely manner and two employees, Gus and Bernie are model employees from what I've seen keeping the bar very clean, smiling, answering questions, coordinating with kitchen staff, etc...! I'm not sure I can give a much better review but I did want to recognize those two employees and the kitchen staff! I gave 4 instead of 5 stars not due to the staff or restaurant itself but the guests that frequent here. It's a lot of college kids and they are just very annoying, too busy taking selfies with masks on and in their own world and getting up to the counter with no idea what they want and holding up the line pretty significantly while they browse the menu instead of deciding what they want in the ample amount of time they have while waiting since they only allow 10 people inside at a time.

We had been looking forward to dining here for months! First, the food and aesthetics of the restaurant were wonderful. It has an old school steak house feel, it reminded me of Crescent City Steaks, just more modern. It's so disheartening and disrespectful in 2019 to still deal with blatantly different service in a fine dining establishment due to race (it was the only difference between us and the other restaurant patrons). Especially in a city whose main economic draw is tourism. Either they don't realize you notice it or maybe they just don't give a f÷@%! I can only speak on the experience we had at this restaurant, if our treatment was due to something other than race we could not identify it. We dine out a lot, everything from holes in the wall to fine dining establishments and sadly this type of treatment is still very prevalent. We pride ourselves on being exceptional tippers 20% is our norm. I will tip a lackluster server no less than 15%. I tip this way because I understand they don't think "we" are tipping at all let alone tipping properly. Needless to say, we won't be back anytime soon. I will say we have dined at their sister restaurant Desi Vega and the service was amazing!

Being in town on a work trip I looked up top places to come. Let me tell you, I was not disappointed. Both service and food were amazing. I'm picky about my oysters and how they're prepared, and these were probably the best oysters I've ever had. This is a must, if you're in the area and looking for a top notch experience.

If you know anything about me, know that I like eating tacos, I'm especially fond of eating those inauthentic tex mex versions at Taco Bell and Del Taco. 

I recently had a craving for Del Taco. It used to be my favorite taco joint, but I hadn't been there for quite a long time. It is not located near where I live, so it's a shlep, but I had a craving, so off I went. 

This visit happened to coincide with the brand new meatless tacos. I came in during a slow period, and ordered one along with a beef taco. Both were well portioned with plenty of meat, cheese, and lettuce. The combination highlighted what I really enjoyed about it. 

The only problem I had was that the place was a bit sloppy. It was difficult for me to find a clean tabletop. The salsa holder near the counter was disgusting. It looked like someone dropped salsa inside, and it was sticky and dry. The taco fillings were also haphazardly put together.

Still, it was cheap, it was filling, and it satisfied me. I'll probably be back.
Curbside pick up, wait over 30 mins , have not get my food yet. Order 20:11, and it is 20:42 now. What is wrong with you guys ?

my (visiting-from-out-of-town) friends and i needed a place with the wifi and the caffeine, but also wanted non-coffee-shop snacks. thank the remote work deities, we stumble upon white bison. this place is absolute perfection. 7-11-meets-coffee-shop-meets-lounge-meets-happiness. typical coffee and tea selections, both local and nationally-recognized snacks, and plenty of indoor and outdoor space to sit, lounge, and (if need be) study/work for hours on end. the fireplaces were perfect for the slight winter chill. definitely the best spot to bring your laptop and zombied-out self.

We had a great lunch.  I ordered the short rib grilled cheese, my husband had a Caesar salad. The food was delicious and the service was excellent.  Thanks to our server Brett who did an excellent job.  We will definitely be back.

Love this place!  Excellent quality and attentive staff. The food is always fresh and delicious.  I especially enjoy the crab cake sandwich on the lunch menu and there are some great options on the Sunday brunch menu.  Only criticism is that they could use a bit more variety on the dinner menu.

Definitely some of the rudest  service I've ever had. "Kathy" who was working the drive-through made it quite obvious that I was interrupting whatever it is she was doing before I got there. I ordered one meal and a pizza slider. Arrive to an empty window at the drive-through and sat there for about 5 minutes. "Kathy" eventually came from around the corner took my money and asked if I'd like any sauce. Not politely, clearly  annoyed...that I was alive... she hands me my order I pull out and realized she forgot the Coke. So we park going with the receipt and stand in an empty restaurant at the counter where she can definitely see us but does not acknowledge we are there....so I say "hey-we didn't get out coke." She doesn't even turn to look at us...looks at the poor older lady-behind the counter with her and apparently someone else she's comfortable pushing around and said "can you get her a cup?" No apology no acknowledgment, nothing. So I asked the lovely older lady who gave me a cup with the girls name was...She looked like she was afraid to tell me the name...   i'm not gonna say I won't go back to this Arby's because it's the only Arby's in Reno and I know better, haha I'll be back... but someone needs to touch base with that girl, she is clearly having issues.... she's taking it out on your customers and I think also the nice older lady that she's working with. Her manager should be embarrassed...

So happy to roll up at 12:10pm with immediate outdoor seating for a beautiful fall day!  First visit to this location and really happy we did!

At our table we had Sweet Plum Burger and Millionaire Burger.  Both were divine with unique sauces that added a level of sweet to the savory burger. The fries were solid and their side salad had great variety.  Love the house made dressings and I elected for the horseradish poppyseed....big hit!  My parents always share and they had fish and chips along with the baby wedge salad. They enjoyed both equally and was the right amount of found for them!

Great stop before we headed to Newfields for an afternoon of fun!
The value for the portion and flavors is UNREAL! I got the jerk chicken cheesesteak with fried plantains and rice and peas and I can't stop thinking about it! Delicious! Can't wait to try more!

Love this place! Great sandwiches and coffee drinks. Stopped in after church for a quick bite. Got and egg sandwich and Nutella latte. The sandwich was filling and the latte was delicious, not too sweet! The place and cups/plates/utensils are clean, which I appreciate. Price is reasonable for philly.
Unprofessional, cash only, no receipt available - shady business & bland pizza with no flavor

Cheese sticks were the best thing here. The "seafood" was a joke unless you like mayonnaise stuffed mushrooms and some half assed canned crab cakes and some frozen "ahi". Also the "manager"" was a douche canoe. ‍ Save yourself and go get fish and chips from McDonalds. The #7.

Every one of these five stars is earned by this amazing bakery.  We indulged in a boudin king cake this morning and it's amazing.  Over stuffed with boudin and topped with Parmesan cheese in carnival colors.  Super savory.  The friendly woman at the walk up window advised we wrap the cake in aluminum foil to reheat at home and if we wanted a crispier brioche to spray the inside of the foil with Pam.  Don't miss out on this one, we had ours with fried eggs this morning.  Our next one will be their crawfish king cake.
The have a lot of respect for the manager. He has made some changes that were needed by hiring people that are committed to the Bazbeaux's standard of the best pizza in Indianapolis. Glad to be back.

How do you mess up pancakes? The pancakes here are sour tasting. Leaves a really disgusting after taste. Husband got the chicken and waffles. Those were okay. But I will never be back simply because the food is not palatable. We preordered our food and picked it up. Their website is not optimized for ordering using your phone to order (can't get to the cart) so I had to use an actual computer. Smh

A pearl in NOLA. This city eats, drinks, and sometimes sleeps...this place is a way to get a healthy meal option with amazing smoothies and salads. I got the PB&J and it was so good I almost got a job just for the recipe.

Come. Enjoy.
We had a great meal here our last night of vacation. All of the food was really good and our server Anthony took great care of us. I can't wait to visit again on our next trip.

I stopped in to have a latte. I selected the July special raspberry and white mocha and I enjoyed the taste. The atmosphere of Ike's reminds me of establishments in DC. It is cozy and built for efficiency. As a college professor, I like to look for coffee places that are a little more inviting so I can stay and do some research and writing. Even without the Covid-19 pandemic, Ike's does not present the atmosphere I am looking for in a coffee house. If you are in a hurry and just want a drink and some food, you will probably like this place. It was clean, the staff were friendly, and the food looked appetizing.

Had dinner here for the first time last night and was very impressed with our meal.   
The service was very good, atmosphere was very Italian (I'm married to one) and my wife said the Gnocchi was very fresh and very good!   
After having pizza at a number of places in the area, I think we found our favorite.  It was authentic, fresh, flavorful with the PERFECT crust that made you want more!   Just give me a side order of crust please : )
My only complaint is they aren't closer to home. 
They are certainly on our pizza / Italian dinner rotation from now on.   Great job!!!!

Tucked in the center of Don Cesar, is this beautiful luxurious spa. "Spa Oceana" - It's the best kept secret spot just past a relaxing garden, on your way to the pool. 
Once I was inside I was greeted by sweet cast/technician who promptly took the temperature of my forehead. I noticed a few friendly stylists and spa technicians. Everyone was so welcoming. We all wore a mask. 
The spa is gorgeous with a ruby red magnificent chandelier in the lobby. I was led through to the stylist station, I was trying to take it all in at once because every where I looked it's beautifully designed, decorated and stocked. The pedicure station looked both elegant and relaxing with long white curtains from the high vaulted ceiling, sea glass bowls and relaxing massage chairs... at the end the view of the Gulf of Mexico through a picture window. 
I was SO lucky to have Jess Dolce as my hairstylist who recently relocated to Florida. I needed some serious repair on a hair color gone wrong by a bad copper rusty color job, mixed with new growth of grey. When Jess told me he has been doing hair for 30 years, has owned his own salon, has done actors on movie sets...I knew I was in good hands. I was feeling emotional when he finished my hair, completely corrected, it looks so natural like it grew this way, I feel like he took 15 years off my head. The product he used is perfectly named "Love" 
He used a fabulous conditioning mask called "let it go" it was mixed with eucalyptus, lime, citrus and it was s

I'm officially a @datz4foodies fanatic!!

Cheat meal during the weekend, along with some amazing people to share it with. 

1. Stuffed acorn squash (vegan dish!) with corn, black beans, onions, and Beyond Meat crumbles. Mashed potatoes underneath. Had the best sweet n smokey balance.

2. (My dish!) Meatloaf stuffed with jalapeño-bacon mac n cheese topped with a ketchup glaze. With mashed potatoes and bacon brussel sprouts so delicious i would just order a plate of that myself! (Which is huge because I normally despise brussels) 

3. The Pork Shank Redemption. One of the new items on the menu. Soft, buttery pork shank served with mashed potatoes and bacon brussels as well. 

4. The Porkfection sandwich. This sandwich is stuffed with shredded pork, ham, pork belly, and tobasco fried onion rings,  along with homemade chips on a bread similar to French and Cuban combined. 

The drinks were also amazing, I highly recommend the "Kelly" drink and, as pictured, the Night Fury, a drink sweet and bursting full of edible glitter! 
I will definitely be going here again,  hopefully this time I can try the Naughty by Nature drink, which has an edible scorpion!

Yum.  Salmon, tuna, and shrimp poke bowl eith crab, seaweed salad, and fresh veggies hit the spot.  Made to order and delivery by grub hub.  Less than 30 min wait.  Easy ordering online.

Very tasty, healthy, flavorful and not overpowering.

Located in South Reno on Damonte Parkway in the Walmart Shopping Center. Grub hub texts you when the order is on your doorstep.

The Pho smelled delightful.

Prices are great!  Nice way to break up a busy day at work!

We love love love this place and their new location on Bridge street is further from our house but we go more often because it's bigger and has a bar and beer garden. They've done a fantastic job of takeout and curbside pickup during COVID. Very friendly staff. Very clean and professional location. Go! You'll love it.

This wonderful neighborhood restaurant (s) is offering curbside pick up and delivery. It was really fun to have a familiar face from the Theresa's next door drop off wonderful comfort food.   
      For many years I have been enjoying their tomato carrot soup with very tender meatballs in house. We ordered two orders along with our grilled tuna.     The tuna was great and delicious, very simple and hit the spot, but I felt the need to give a spotlight to the soup. I have never had the soup at room temperature because I've never had their takeout before. My first few bites were simply delightful. I almost recommend eating half the soup at room temperature because all of the yummy flavors. This soup is almost like fresh puréed veggies with delicate delectable meatballs. I love this soup. It's a wonderful spring dish although I have enjoyed it and could also equally recommend it as a heartwarming winter soother. Last nights batch was delicious. I will be ordering it again today as soon as they open. One of our semi permanent houseguests ordered the double cheeseburgers. Two cheeseburgers arrived that looked really delicious. I snuck a quick nibble of the potatoes that came with and wished I'd had more.
       Keep in mind Theresa's has amazing selections of beer and spirits for takeout as well when you pick out your take out/delivery.  
      I look forward to ordering some of their wonderful cheeses, olives, charcuterie meats and fabulous chicken wings. I recommend their cinnam

i ordered a Smokehouse Beef & Brisket sub for my wife and i ordered an Italian for myself. we got our food quickly, and my wife loved her sub, as she usually does. mine was ok, and i ended up saving half for later. well, i came home from work and was planning on having the rest of my sub and was only two bites deep only to find a massive hair in it!

at first i thought it was a stringy piece of cheese, so i pulled on it only to see inches and inches of long blonde hair!!! i know that in the food industry things like this happen, but if your hair is this damn long, you ought to know better. prepare thyself to handle one's food, damn it! 

ridiculous. and gross. this has ruined Firehouse for me, because their subs are nothing compared to Publix (where they actually use hair nets) so i hope you found this review to be helpful (or at least funny) but i strongly urge you to choose somewhere else!

Possibly the worst combination  service and food that I have had in a very long time. Called in a take out order and told that it would be ready in 20 - 25 min. arrived on time, order not ready. told it would be 10 min. after 20 min, no food. asked about order. waitress said she would check. food came out after another 10 min. waited 30 extra minutes for our order. GUARANTEE our original order was never put in

Order was incorrect. Burgers undercooked. Wrong cheese on roast beef. I was up most of the night, not feeling well. Now, 13 hrs later, still not feeling great.

Will not go back. STAY AWAY! If could give no stars, I would.

Loved my experience at Skyline Kitchen and Vine!  The service was top notch and everything on the menu looked amazing. It took forever for my friend and I to decide on what small plates to get because we wanted to order one of everything! 

We started with a drink - Huckleberry Hooch. Wow, so good!  Very refreshing and tasty. That helped us narrow down our food selection to bruschetta, artichoke hearts, and the rib sliders. The food was served promptly and tasted fantastic. I wish I would have known about Happy Hour because we were eating before 5 but our waitress didn't mention anything and we didn't see any flyers or leaflets on the table. Maybe it's been discontinued for right now?  

I will definitely be back to try other menu items!  And thank you for making the reservation process so simple. I open my Yelp app and can make reservations right from there. Love it!
Amazing vibes at party fowl!!! New manmosa, Red Bull vodka mimosa goes crazy! The food and drinks are too good!! Recommend ten times out of ten.

My son and I came here on a Thursday night and was seated immediately.  We've only had oysters once before and didnt like them so we were not going to order them. I kept seeing people order them, so I decided to give them another try. Best decision ever!  The chargrilled oysters were so yummy, the sauce that's put on it takes it to the next level. We were dipping our other food that we ordered in what was left of it.   We both agreed that we must come here again for the oysters before we leave.

Finally visited Rook after hearing nothing but good things for years! Initially the steamed buns are what drew me in. We tried one of each: jalapeño spam, fried avocado, and pork tenderloin. Each were great and I would consider ordering one of each as a meal alone. My husband doesn't like avocados usually (I don't get it either!) but really enjoyed the fried avocado. I think it's great to eat after the spam to cool down the spice and salt. Pork tenderloin is exactly what you would expect and it's great! I tried the Pig Face Hash which balanced each of the ingredients beautifully and my husband enjoyed the spicy Dan Dan noodles. The sauce was a bit rich for my taste and not as spicy as you might expect. I enjoyed the Big Momma Thang which was $11 but trust me, it was $11 worth of drink! Great experience and will be back! We were too full to try the halo halo but I won't make that mistake next time!

CAUTION!!!!!
 

anyone with any food allergies please steer clear of Olive Garden. 

I ordered gluten-free pasta,  when we picked it up we confirmed that it was gluten-free pasta. We got home I noticed it looks a little different because it was angel hair not rotini.  They  told me it was gf 3 times, he read back my order, when we picked it up we asked twice. It was NOT gluten free!!!!

I'm in incredible pain and I will be for the next 7-10 days.

We used G's Pizza a lot during quarantine although I'm not sure if it was this location or another.  They have a great variety of toppings for vegetarians. I was surprised when I found out the crust was gluten free because I was a big fan of the crust.

My boyfriend got this catered at his base and he said it was amazing so he took me there for lunch today. I got a chance to look at the menu online beforehand so I already knew what I wanted- the All In Bowl. They have a good setup in there, a little assembly line so I could just say what I wanted at each little station and they added it to my bowl right in front of me. The place is super cool inside too, felt really upbeat. We sat at a barstool table and ate, and let me say, the food was AMAZING. There were so many flavors and nothing that I got in the bowl disappointed me. Unfortunately it's a little far from where I live, so I can't go that often. But it's near my bf's base so anytime we're down here it's def the place we're going.

Delicious food, and quick service! We ordered takeout at this restaurant. The staff was quick and attentive. The food was even better. I definitely recommend the seared tuna bowl if you are on a diet. You can not go wrong with any of the tacos. The shells are made from scratch and delicious!

This place is delicious! While coming to boise to pick up someone from the airport I found this gem! The falafel was amazing and they had a ton of options for vegetarians which I appreciated! All the ingredients tasted fresh and the staff were all wearing masks and had sanitizer available. The only bummer is that I don't live closer because I want to try everything!

I live in the area and frequent this Taco Bell regularly.  Without fail, they are always out of something.  To the point that it's now a joke, each time before I order, I ask what are you out of.  Tonight they were out of beef.  It's always something, out of tortilla or hard shell, etc.  a serious mismanagement issue.  Also I've never encountered the same worker twice.  Terribly managed with a serious inventory issue.  Once, I ordered a bean burrito and the beans were so dry and old I couldn't eat it. There was no cheese no sauce and there was some kind of dried up burnt crunchy beef in it.  Not sure why I keep going back. But when it's late night and there's nothing else open open, I keep giving it another try.

Freddy, what happened??? We have been regulars at this location since it opened & tell everybody about the awesome burgers. But this location has really gone downhill. We love the food and the recent blue cheese and bacon burger now available is sooo good. 
But the past three times we've been here the floors and tables have been dirty with napkins and fries on the floor.  Tonite a "caution wet floor" sign was knocked down on the floor and we saw a lady trip over it. No wet floor but the sign was a hazard! A customer picked it up and moved it. 
When the employee calls out the number you can't understand a word of it. Muffled while loud. That goes for the custard/shake orders microphone and the food orders microphone. So people congregate up at the counter so they don't miss their food which causes congestion. 
Tonite the line is out the door and onto the sidewalk the whole time we are here. Only one worker taking orders at dinner time on a Sunday? 
I really want to keep loving this place but I think I'll give it one last try and then give up.

Cold food, salsa all tasted old. For being only one of the Mexican places, they could use a better chef. Also better staff. Seemed like everyone was unhappy working, only person cleaning up was helpful. Will not be back!

I went to Tradesman's for Monday Night Football. While enjoying the game and some food I saw a mouse run throughout the restaurant. I told the bartenders and they did not care. They said that is what happens when you have a restaurant in the city. They told me they have caught hundreds of them. They acted so relax and calm as if this is an everyday thing, which only makes me wonder what goes on in the Kitchen!?!
